name: racing-line-hazard-recovery-v1

reproduction.duplicate_outcome: exact step/action/trajectory replay on the same cell

hypothesis.failure: After two hazard frames the controller replaces an active overspeed brake with gas, so the car accelerates while still outside the road envelope.
hypothesis.repair: Preserve longitudinal braking while above the hazard target and emit only the bounded crawl command after speed is safe.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Remove overspeed reacceleration without changing steering, perception thresholds, obstacle detection, neural weights, official environment files, or the frozen DrQ studies.
hypothesis.rejected_before_execution: A proposed look-ahead hazard-steering change was rejected by the synthetic envelope test: the final near-road vehicle-envelope gate correctly retains authority when near and far road directions conflict. No steering change remains in this experiment.

unit: A persistent blocked view above hazard target speed must keep gas at zero and retain braking after the initial hold.
A persistent blocked view below hazard target speed may resume only HAZARD_CRAWL_GAS after the initial hold.
All existing controller, inference, contract, and submission tests pass.
recorded_replay: No blocked frame may cancel an overspeed brake to apply gas.

consumed_development_smoke.minimum_result: strictly improve finish first, otherwise progress above 0.8162544169611308 without damage or collision regression
consumed_development_smoke.interpretation: diagnostic only; this reused public cell cannot promote, unlock blind, or establish generalization

abort: Any official interface, core, env_wrapper.py, damage.py, model.pt, DrQ protocol, run artifact, or reserved seed is modified.
The repair needs perception-threshold tuning or a second independent optimization axis.
Relevant tests regress or the consumed-development smoke fails the minimum result.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent.
No fresh evaluation, submission, or SOTA claim is authorized until those sources are restored and audited.
